title: A connected detection region need not represent one physical target
observed_problem: Four paired-target cases fail the final two-record criterion despite two local Power maxima both surviving CFAR. Detected cells connect the maxima into one component in both stored Float and selected-C Fixed outputs.
initial_faulty_assumption_or_design_deci: Design simplification: emit only the maximum-Power record of each eight-connected detected region. This policy does not preserve multiplicity when a region contains two eligible peaks.
observable_consequence: The tested component reducer emits one nearby record and the paired-target requirement remains FAIL4/8, while its deterministic oracle equivalence can still PASS.
assessed_root_cause: A requirement-to-extractor compatibility gap for the retained connected masks. Not evidence of a coding error in the approved grouping algorithm or proof of general physical resolvability.
chosen_corrective_method: Proposed only: retain CFAR and investigate multi-peak extraction/deblending per region with independently specified spacing/prominence/plateau and record semantics. No implementation selected or approved.
alternatives_and_negative_results: Retain old component policy and explicitly carry resolution limitation; no automatic PASS
A new3dB valley rule would reject the four observed failed examples and is not the approved historical criterion
Blindly emitting every local maximum risks false targets from noise/sidelobes
repeatable_validation: Check pinned output archives, inspect Power profiles at natural Doppler4 and retained CFAR masks; compare to accepted eight-connected single-maximum policy. Existing standalone diagnostic JSONs record the observations. Do not run historical mutating validators.
generalizable_lesson: Validate the mapping from detection regions to target records against required target multiplicity. Bit-true agreement with an oracle proves implementation consistency, not suitability of the selected extraction contract.
applicability: Post-CFAR target extraction where adjacent detections can bridge multiple local peaks.
non_applicability: Does not prove every local maximum is a separate target, guarantee resolution in noise, prescribe a universal valley threshold, or invalidate connected components as region formation.
safety_contract_constraints: Stable code, approved criteria, historical PASS/FAIL, Gate states and output-capacity acceptance unchanged. Further design/tests require explicit bounded authorization.
reviewer_role: Pending engineer review; no independent human review claimed
time_provenance: Current archive-analysis time, not original experiment time
